zh: 这两年我一直在学英语。
old_en: I have been learning English for these two years.
new_en: I have been learning English for two years.

zh: 她最近一直在找新工作。
old_en: She has been searching for a new job recently.
new_en: She has been looking for a new job recently.

zh: 孩子一直在哭，怎么哄都不行。
old_en: The child has been crying nonstop, no matter what I try to soothe her.
new_en: The child has been crying no matter what I do.

zh: 我一直在准备考试。
old_en: I have been studying for the exam non-stop.
new_en: I have been preparing for the exam.

zh: 他从去年开始一直在学英语。
old_en: He has been learning English since last year.
new_en: He has been learning English since last year.

zh: 他最近一直在加班。
old_en: He has been working overtime recently.
new_en: He has been working overtime recently.

zh: 这段时间我们一直在加班。
old_en: We have been working overtime during this period.
new_en: We have been working overtime during this period.

zh: 我在门口等了一个小时。
old_en: I have been waiting at the door for an hour.
new_en: I have been waiting at the door for an hour.

zh: 她已经在车站等了半个小时。
old_en: She has been waiting at the station for half an hour.
new_en: She has been waiting at the station for half an hour.

zh: 这几天一直都在下雨。
old_en: It has been raining for several days.
new_en: It has been raining for several days.

zh: 最近一直下雨，出门很不方便。
old_en: It has been raining constantly lately, making it very inconvenient to go out.
new_en: It has been raining lately, making it hard to go out.

zh: 我在这家公司工作了五年。
old_en: I have been working at this company for five years.
new_en: I have been working at this company for five years.

zh: 他在这家工厂已经工作了八年。
old_en: He has been working at this factory for eight years.
new_en: He has been working at this factory for eight years.

zh: 我们一直在找房子。
old_en: We have been looking for a house.
new_en: We have been looking for a house.

zh: 宝宝已经哭了半个小时了。
old_en: The baby has been crying for half an hour.
new_en: The baby has been crying for half an hour.

zh: 他最近一直在锻炼身体。
old_en: He has been exercising regularly recently.
new_en: He has been exercising lately.

zh: 为了减肥，她一直在锻炼。
old_en: She has been exercising to lose weight.
new_en: She has been exercising to lose weight.

zh: 我学开车学了两个月。
old_en: I have been learning to drive for two months.
new_en: I have been learning to drive for two months.

zh: 她学游泳学了三个月。
old_en: She has been learning swimming for three months.
new_en: She has been learning to swim for three months.

zh: 最近他一直在准备考试，很少出门。
old_en: He has been preparing for exams recently, going out very little.
new_en: He has been studying for exams recently and goes out rarely.
